environment_caveats: Audited the Cloudflare Pages staging preview because clients/quality-contracting-inc.json still has no apex_cutover.completed_at. HOWEVER, https://qualitycontracting.us/ no longer serves the old WordPress/Kinsta site: it now returns the Rank AI Astro build via Cloudflare (IndexNow key /92370eb0990e4d9a832d8b93a4bd94ef.txt returns 200, no x-robots-tag, client record deploy_url is https://qualitycontracting.us). The apex cutover appears to have happened without completed_at being recorded.

The apex and staging builds are NOT identical: different CSS bundle hashes (_slug_.B3bBBMuK.css on apex vs _slug_.A-a6aXyj.css on staging), apex serves inner-page images from images.qualitycontracting.us, apex homepage hero markup differs (lg:grid layout), and apex CTA buttons use bg-cta tokens where staging uses bg-primary-600. Staging appears to lag production, so this staging audit may not reflect what visitors and Google see.

GET https://staging.rankai-quality-contracting-inc.pages.dev/ returns x-robots-tag: noindex (injected by Cloudflare Pages on *.pages.dev). is-crawlable fails on all 6 URLs and deflates SEO to 69. SEO is inconclusive and was excluded from every verdict; verdicts use performance, accessibility and best_practices only.
Canonical tags on all 6 staging pages point to https://qualitycontracting.us/..., which is correct for a staging preview and is not recorded as an issue.
Lighthouse 13.4.0 ran desktop only (formFactor desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier 1, throughputKbps 10240). Mobile scores would typically run 10-20 performance points lower.

One diagnostic Lighthouse plus instant_pages pair was run against https://qualitycontracting.us/ (apex homepage) outside the 6-URL audit set to check the cutover. It is not counted in audited_urls or the verdict: performance 99, accessibility 100, best_practices 100, SEO 100, LCP 895ms, CLS 0.036.
